servers: Through the kit only (places.geocode and places.overpass, D27, Legal L55 and L57): one server for each, 127's own in live runs, never a rotation of public mirrors. Live runs without 127's servers are held and show sample shops (places.HELD_NOTE). Server addresses carry keys, so none is saved, shown or logged here.

rules: One query at a time per member (never in parallel).
One server, one pause and one retry, then a plain busy note (kit places.overpass).
Cache results (we keep a city's shop list for 24 hours).

attribution.where: Views: places.creditBlocks (adds Search by LocationIQ.com when LocationIQ looked up the city). Spreadsheets: places.creditLine as the last row. Pages: places.creditHtml.

note: OpenStreetMap is free and community made: coverage varies by city, and many shops have no website listed. Every list says so and links each shop to its OpenStreetMap page.
